title: Suspension of Purple Worm Slime
summary: Alchemical extract used for Purple Worm Toxin.

fields.Extract: Combine 3 Purple Worm Gullets to make one Suspension of Purple Worm Slime.
fields.Brew: Combine this extract with any Vitriol to make Purple Worm Toxin.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
